item.text: The ACT Integrity Commission assessed a corruption complaint referred after parliamentary scrutiny of the sale of a Dickson car park to the Tradies Club.
item.support: The Committee’s referral was accepted by the Commission as a corruption complaint

item.text: It examined the sale process and the government’s linked purchase of land at Downer.
item.support: examined the facts surrounding the sale of Block 30 and the purchase of the Downer site

item.text: The Commission concluded that the sale met legal requirements and raised no reasonable suspicion of corruption, although some decisions needed better documentation.
item.support: the Commission found that the land sale process itself was adequate and complied with all necessary legal requirements

item.text: It discontinued the matter because it considered further action on the corruption report unjustified.
item.support: further dealing with the corruption report is not justified
